Hey kids
I wanted to let you know that I’m gonna take a little break from social media.

media:group.media:title: Important Reminder from Dad
media:group.media:description:
#CologuardPartner
If you’re 45 or older, this is your reminder. Colon cancer is THE #1 leading cause of cancer-related death in the US for adults under the age of 50.
The @Cologuard Plus test is screening that can be done on your schedule, without a procedure.
If you’re 45+ and at average risk, ask your healthcare provider about screening for colon cancer with the Cologuard Plus® test or request a prescription online.
The Cologuard® and Cologuard Plus™ tests are intended to screen adults 45 years of age and older who are at average risk for colorectal cancer by detecting certain DNA markers and blood in the stool. Do not use the Cologuard products if you have: Had adenomas, which are a type of colon polyp that can sometimes become cancer; inflammatory bowel disease or other hereditary syndromes; a personal or first-degree family history of colorectal cancer; or a positive result from another colon cancer screening method within that test's recommended screening interval.
Talk to your healthcare provider if any of these situations apply to you.
Cologuard results should be interpreted with caution. A positive test result does not confirm the presence of cancer. Patients with a positive test result should be referred for colonoscopy. A negative test result does not confirm the absence of cancer. Patients with a negative test result should discuss with their doctor when they need to be tested again. False positives and false negative results can occur. Rx only.
@Cologuard

entry.title: I Now Have a Separate Channel called “Dad’s Faith Channel”

media:group.media:title: I Now Have a Separate Channel called “Dad’s Faith Channel”
media:group.media:description:
New channel
Hey kids,
I truly hope you’re well today!
You may have noticed that I removed the series on tough questions from this channel.
When I decided to do that series, I was hoping to help make sense of the deeper questions in life. As I have always said, there’s more to life than unclogging a toilet.
As I mentioned, I see far too many people, especially our youth struggling with anxiety, depression and a lack of hope.
My faith gives me hope, and the word gospel means good news, I would honestly say it’s not good news, it’s the best news ever, so I was hoping to share that good news with you.
Unfortunately, many people were offended and it kind of went off the rails.
I have never been one who wants to corner people and make them feel trapped, or forced to hear what I have to say.
I think part of being a man is apologizing when you’ve done something wrong, so I wanted to take a moment to apologize to you. I’m sorry if that felt like it came out of nowhere… like a bit of a jump scare. That wasn’t my intention, and I hope you can forgive me.
I also want to apologize if some of my responses came across harsh. I was honestly a little surprised by how vicious some people were, so I probably got a little defensive.
So moving forward, I want to be more intentional.
This channel will stay focused on what it’s always been about—practical help, encouragement, and showing up for you in a way that’s useful and relatable.
And for those of you who do want to hear more about the deeper conversations, including my faith—I have started a separate channel for that. called “Dads Faith Channel”.
It’s already active, and I have moved my series on tough questions there.
That way, you can choose what you want to be a part of, and nothing feels forced, or like someone is dragging you to church.
I appreciate all of you—seriously. Even your honest feedback. It means you care enough to say something, and I respect that.
Thanks for being here.
God bless you

entry.title: Dad's Go-To Peanut Butter Cookies | You Need This Recipe

media:group.media:title: Dad's Go-To Peanut Butter Cookies | You Need This Recipe
media:group.media:description:
Dad's Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
Ingredients ½ cup butter (softened) ½ cup sugar ½ cup brown sugar 1 cup peanut butter 1 egg 1 tsp vanilla 1¼ cups flour ½ tsp baking soda ¼ tsp salt 1 tbsp Cinnamon
Preheat oven to 350°F Cream butter + sugars Add peanut butter, egg, vanilla Mix flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon Combine wet and dry ingredients Roll into balls, fork press Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar mixture Bake 12 minutes Enjoy!
